maddeler.e:
يحتجزوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِزُوا (yaḥtajizū) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يُحْتَجَزُوا (yuḥtajazū) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
